title: Red Teaming Language Models to Reduce Harms: Methods, Scaling Behaviors, and Lessons Learned

bias_targets.methodology: Manual open-ended red teaming where human adversaries attempt to elicit racist language from the dialogue model, evaluated via self-reported attack success ratings and automated harmlessness preference model scores.
Human-in-the-loop adversarial dialogues designed to solicit insults based on physical characteristics, identified and evaluated via post-hoc semantic embedding and clustering of attack transcripts.
Analyzing the frequency and attack success rate of red team conversations manually annotated with 'Discrimination & injustice' and 'soliciting discriminatory responses' tags.
